output.summary: The denial can be addressed by providing the required retroactive authorization request and following the established appeal steps. Relevant precedents that do not apply have been identified.

items.text: Submit a retroactive authorization request as required by clause C-2025-INPATIENT-PREAUTH.
Attach the discharge summary to the request.
Submit the appeal within the appeal window.
The MRI referral precedent (F-MRI-REFERRAL) does not apply because this claim involves inpatient surgery, not an MRI, and is governed by a different clause.
The sleep‑study retroactive authorization precedent (F-SLEEP-RETRO) is inapplicable; it concerns a different service type and has been contradicted by rulings R-HC-010 and R-HC-011.
